name: camayoc_principal_consumption_by_provider
description: verification-and-liveness Q17: what a principal consumed in a half-open time window [from, to), grouped by provider. The window aggregation is a read-time judgment over observed records; nothing decaying is stored.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?provider (SUM(?tokens) AS ?totalTokens) WHERE { ?record a aegis:UsageRecord ; aegis:inSession ?session ; aegis:provider ?provider ; aegis:observedAt ?at ; aegis:tokensConsumed ?tokens . ?session aegis:actor <{principal}> . FILTER(?at >= "{from}" && ?at < "{to}") } GROUP BY ?provider ORDER BY ?provider
